description: In every expanded structure and assignment, the fixed translation of the native formula of an original clause \(C\) has the same truth value as the actual native shared relation-clause formula of \(C^E\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.originalClause_translate_truth.{u, v, w, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {α : Type w} {N : Type z} [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Extended L).Structure N]
  (C : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.OriginalClause L α) (v : α → N) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Formula.Realize
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.translate
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.originalClauseFormula C))
      v ↔
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseToFormula
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.translateClause C)).Realize
      v
